reporting-org.narrative: ORRAAs mission is to build the resilience of 250 million climate vulnerable coastal people by 2030, by deploying at least USD$500 million of investment into coastal and ocean resilience through the development of at least 50 novel finance and insurance products.

description.narrative: The Western Indian Ocean’s rich ecosystems generate over $20.8bn annually, yet face rapid degradation, threatening coastal communities. This project pilots an innovative seascape financing model in Tanzania’s RUMAKI seascape, a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, to support 28,000 people through sustainable blue economy livelihoods. By strengthening community-led fisheries management and microfinance initiatives, it ensures long-term protection of 18,470ha of coastal ecosystems. Lessons will scale across WWF’s 15 SWIO seascapes, advancing global commitments on biodiversity, climate resilience, and sustainable development.
